from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Captures the specific financial figures for a company in a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The period covered, e.g., 2025-03 or 2025-Q1")
    monetary_funds: float = Field(description="Amount of monetary funds (currency units)")
    accounts_payable: float = Field(description="Amount of accounts payable (currency units)")
    contract_liabilities: float = Field(description="Amount of contract liabilities (currency units)")
    operating_cash_flow_net: float = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities (currency units)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all company financial data from the collection."""
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialMetrics]
